gaps: The muzzle is still long and straight in profile: the domed cranium and deeper jaw soften the crocodile read, but the concept's shorter greyhound face with a visible stop is not matched.
Head-on the eye slits read small and dim beside the concept's large glowing eyes, and the face is narrower than the concept's broad lit head.
Glow hue is the project's amber (F08C2C): the engine grille is hue 35 to 42 against the concept's 25, and in the Blender compare the grille and lenses read peach at the GLOW_STRENGTH 0.7 convention.
Ruby saturation falls short of the concept (engine S 0.50 to 0.61 against 0.86): the warm key lights and the gunmetal slot's 0.42 roughness, 0.7 metallic add a pale specular.
The tail hangs to a key at z 0.45 m, where the concept's tail curls back up to a key at about 0.54 m; the far-side legs are not staggered and the rest stance is symmetric.
Legs are still mostly plated cylinders below the forearm and gaskin; paws are simpler than the concept's arched, individually jointed toes.
In the engine idle frame the chest prow's key-light highlight lifts the chest brass to V 0.63 (concept 0.45 to 0.53); the whole-body median is in range.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 21/30, signature features 20/25, surface detail and material read 13/20, colour and value 13/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from spring-hound.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's side, front and back angles, framed at the concept's own metres per pixel: side 1.2 m / 855 px, front and back 1.21 m / 875 px) side by side, from close EEVEE crops of the chest, side lens, head and bosses, and from the six in-engine shots in staging/engine, which now bind the brass slots with the manifest tint and render hound-glow through the runtime D11 glow (writeGlowIslands and applyGlowLook from src/enemies/glow.ts). glow-close uses the same 50 degree seat lens as idle for a model this size, so the two frames match. Changes since the 65 review: the cranium is domed (top 1.208 m at y 0.625 against the concept's 1.210) and the jaw is a narrower, deeper wedge; the skull is now aged rather than polished brass, so head-on it reads lit (engine head median V 0.59 against the concept's 0.53) instead of mirroring the dark backdrop; the rose ears fold back over the occiput (top 1.213 m, widest 0.118 m from the midline); the loin is tucked and the keel deepened; the forearm plate bulges at the front and tapers, the gaskin is fuller and the hock has a point. The grille is the single focal light: five 6 mm bars at 25 mm pitch over a flat glow face, and the side lenses are upright slatted ovals (105 mm tall) whose glow sits behind four louvre blades 18 mm deep, so head-on they show brass and from the side the glow shows between the blades. In the engine idle shot the grille's saturated glow is 520 px against about 10 px of visible lens glow. The shoulder and thigh bosses are rubies (COLOR_0 on the gunmetal slot) in polished bezels: engine median about #7B3038 to #884448 (hue 354 to 357, S 0.50 to 0.61, V 0.48 to 0.53) against the concept's #680F23. Engraved gunmetal seams run from the collar to the grille, from the grille ring up to the shoulders and down-outward, and down the shoulder, haunch and forearm plates; each front seam stands 3.7 to 5.1 mm proud of the plate (placed by ray-casting the plate mesh). Rivets ring the collar and the grille. Engine whole-body brass median #846141 (hue 29, S 0.51, V 0.52) against the concept's 24 to 29; gunmetal joints read warm black (#2A1C11). The compare lighting is the fixed warden-matched rig and was not tuned to the score.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the model)

rubric.note: Up 1 from 19. Confirmed on the fidelity compare: the ears now fold back over a domed cranium (side view) instead of flaring like horns, the keel is deeper and the forearm plates bulge and taper. Still off: in profile the muzzle stays a long, straight, flat-topped wedge with no stop, so the head reads rat or possum rather than greyhound, with a row of thin needle teeth along the whole jaw. The hind leg is a near-vertical column from gaskin to paw with only a small hock point, where the concept has a long sloped thigh and a clearly angled hock. Head-on the chest is a broad barrel nearly as wide as the shoulder plates, against the concept's narrow oval chest, and the head sits forward on the coils rather than high on an upright neck.

Up 5 from 16, the main gain. The grille is now the single chest light: in engine idle.jpg every glow pixel (saturation over 0.6, value over 0.85, 444 px) sits in the grille or the eyes, 418 px in the grille box (400,355)-(465,400) and none on the side lenses, which show brass louvres head-on as the concept does. Rubies now sit on the shoulders and thighs in bezels (side compare median (175,42,76), hue 346, against the concept's (93,14,34) to (99,6,31), hue 344 to 345). Coil spine, neck coils, hinged jaw and key tail remain. Deductions: the eyes are tiny, 26 glow px in idle.jpg (box (392,195)-(450,225)) against the concept's large lit eyes; the winding key is two separate octagonal rings on a thin rod (compare crop (940,580)-(1080,700)) rather than the concept's one flat butterfly bow with two holes, and the tail is a thin bead chain against the concept's chunky segments; the rubies are small (57 red px in idle.jpg) and read pink.

Up 2 from 11. Seams, collar and grille rivets and bezels are present and the forearm and hock shapes add plate breaks. But the seams read as single thin black slits (one vertical line down the chest prow in idle.jpg) rather than the concept's layered, bevelled panel edges. The hammered normal still reads as crumpled foil on the head and chest in the Blender compare and as a matte suede on the engine head. The chest prow still carries a pale specular blob in idle.jpg (box (425,320)-(445,345) median (173,136,95), 90th percentile (246,220,185)). Paws remain simple blocks.

Up 1 from 11. Measured with Pillow and NumPy as sRGB medians over a warm-metal mask (max channel over 35, R over B plus 12). Concept side body (138,69)-(1321,950) of the full-resolution sheet median (94,64,48), hue 21, HSV S 0.49, V 0.37, highlight 90th percentile (220,184,119). Engine idle.jpg chest (390,300)-(500,400) (127,89,55), hue 28, V 0.50, and fore-leg column (405,420)-(428,500) (110,79,47), hue 30, V 0.43: warm brass, hue within about 7 to 9 deg of the concept but lighter. The engine floor is (135,95,69), so whole-leg boxes were avoided. Glow matches: engine grille glow (243,185,74), hue 39, against the concept grille glow (249,166,35), hue 37, measured with the same glow mask at (1640,390)-(1760,520) of the full-resolution sheet; the author's 'concept 25' comes from an unmasked box. Faults: the engine head (395,190)-(440,235) is (161,117,79), V 0.63, paler and duller than the chest and the concept head (115,80,54), V 0.45, so the head reads as a separate tan material; rubies are desaturated (engine (131,57,67), HSV S 0.56, against the concept's 0.85 to 0.94); Blender highlights are cream (243,222,197) against the concept's gold (220,184,119).

Level with 8. Gain: the chest now has one focal amber point, so the hit-reaction light has a single place to read (hit.jpg 512 glow px against idle 444). Loss: the eyes are a few pixels at 2.6 m (26 glow px in idle.jpg), so the face reads as a pale tan snout with a black nose rather than the concept's lit glare. The body separates from the floor by value (attack.jpg head (360,330)-(400,420) (182,141,97), V 0.71, against the floor beside it (300,380)-(340,460) (135,99,75), V 0.53). frozen.jpg shows no visible tint shift from idle.jpg; the freeze is the roster-wide runtime ice tint (see the Warden record), so it is noted here but not charged to the hound.

topFixes: Rebuild the head profile: shorten the muzzle and add a visible stop so the head reads greyhound, not rat; drop the needle-teeth row to a few larger teeth near the front as in the concept; and enlarge the eyes into lit slits large enough to read at 2.6 m (now 26 glow px against 418 px for the grille).

Fix the head material and value: the head is matte tan (161,117,79), V 0.63, against chest brass (127,89,55) and the concept head (115,80,54), V 0.45. Put it on the same polished brass as the body and reduce the hammered normal strength, which reads as crumpled foil in Blender and suede in the engine.

Reshape the body and hind legs: narrow the barrel chest toward the concept's oval, slope the hind thigh and angle the hock clearly, make the winding key one flat butterfly bow on a thicker segmented tail, and saturate the rubies (HSV S 0.56 now, concept 0.85 to 0.94).
independentScore.method: Independent re-score of the uncommitted hound refinement on 10d325d with the same five-criterion rubric, re-checking every point of the 65 review against new evidence rather than carrying it forward. Shape was judged on the fidelity compare (orthographic side, front and back at the concept's metres per pixel) with Pillow crops of the side head and the front upper body, and on the review sheet's Blender model, rig and animation rows. In-engine read was judged on the six state shots (idle and glow-close share sha256 6e6c604f, so they are one frame) with an upscaled crop of the idle head and chest. Colour was measured as sRGB medians with HLS/HSV hue, saturation and value over a warm-metal mask, glow as saturation over 0.6 and value over 0.85, rubies as red-hue pixels with saturation over 0.35, all in explicit pixel boxes stated in the notes, with engine boxes kept off the floor (floor (135,95,69)). Concept boxes are in full-resolution 2752x1536 pixels. The art bible (one amber chest core as focal point, jewel inlays at shoulders, polished brass over dark joints) is a secondary check. The in-room Warden crops in /tmp/wtint were not used. The rise from 65 comes mostly from the single grille core and the restored rubies (+5 signature), with smaller gains from the folded ears and domed cranium, the seams and rivets, and the warmer brass.
